issues: List now shows many duplicate uploads from main-agent curl tests + this test (Madura/TWILLS/JOCKEY each present multiple times). Cosmetic only; consider adding a delete/archive affordance or grouping by latest upload per filename in future.
Madura .xlsb renders 8000 rows in DOM at once which is heavy (~3-4s settle). Consider client-side virtualization or server-side pagination for large files.

critical_code_review_comments: PtMapper.tsx grew from 383 -> 508 lines with Phase E additions. Still under 700-line threshold but now hosts PtMapperPage + StageStepper + PtFileDetailPage + ReviewQueuePage + ReviewRow. Recommend splitting per-route (e.g. PtFileDetailPage.tsx) before next phase.
PtFileDetailPage.download() (xlsx/csv) has no loading/error UI states; a network failure silently fails. Add try/catch with setError + a busy state on export buttons.

PtFileDetailPage.action() (rerun/send/post/recall) uses a single shared 'busy' flag and a generic ptfile-action-error region. Functional, but disables ALL action buttons during any in-flight action; acceptable for now.

Edit mode commits all draft cells via PATCH /rows but does NOT validate numeric columns (QTY/MRP/BASIC/etc) before submit. A user can save 'abc' into QTY; backend will need to handle this. Worth a client-side numeric guard on NUM_COLS.

Madura .xlsb: 8000-row hard cap is honoured by backend, but UI renders all 8000 rows un-virtualized. Heavy DOM (~24 cols x 8000 = 192k cells in raw display). Consider virtualization (react-window) for files > ~500 rows.
ROLE GATING is computed only on the client (isWarehouse / isPatna). Confirmed via UI that backend also enforces (rerun returns 409 after send per main-agent curl), so defense-in-depth is in place.

All required data-testids present and stable: pt-upload-dropzone, pt-files-table, pt-file-row-<id>, pt-file-stage-<id>, pt-file-view-<id>, ptfile-stage-badge, ptfile-edit, ptfile-save, ptfile-cancel, ptfile-rerun, ptfile-send, ptfile-post, ptfile-recall, ptfile-export, ptfile-export-xlsx, ptfile-rows-table, pt-cell-<rowId>-<COL>, ptfile-sent-banner, ptfile-posted-banner, ptfile-unresolved-banner, ptfile-ready-banner, ptfile-error, ptfile-action-error, pt-stage-stepper, review-queue-link, review-list, review-item-<id>, review-target-<id>, review-resolve-<id>. Excellent.
